_comment: Every vendored third-party file records the npm package + version it came
from and the sha256 of the exact bytes we serve. scripts/verify_vendor.py
re-downloads the registry tarball and byte-compares, so a tampered or
To add or bump: put the file in clawmetry/static/vendor/, add the entry,
then run `python3 scripts/verify_vendor.py --update` to fill in the hash.

marked.min.js.why: Renders transcript markdown. Output always passes through DOMPurify (cmSafeMarkdown in app.js).
marked.min.js.note: No OSV advisories at this version (checked 2026-08-17). npm latest is 18.x; that is a 5-major jump, so it is deliberately a separate change with transcript-rendering tests, not folded into this one.

purify.min.js.why: Sanitizes transcript markdown before it touches innerHTML. Security-critical.
purify.min.js.note: Upgraded from 3.1.7, which OSV flags for CVE-2025-26791 (mXSS via template literals, fixed in 3.2.4). Not reachable here — that path needs SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES:true and we never set it — but a scanner flags the version regardless, so the finding is removed at the source. No OSV advisories at 3.4.13 (checked 2026-08-17).
